executor_notes: GEE system:time_start is the per-granule instant and spreads 0-26 s within one datatake; it is NOT the acquisition timestamp. The datatake-embedded instant is the acquisition timestamp required by declare_baseline_source_datatake, and it is recoverable with zero mismatches from both PRODUCT_ID field 2 and system:index field 0 across all 2079 scenes.

18 datatakes contain two granules of the same MGRS tile (adjacent datatake segments). They are distinct provider scenes of one physical datatake and remain a single acquisition; the coverage-ranked first-valid composition resolves them per pixel.
110 of 465 UTC dates carry more than one physical datatake, including 20 dates with both S2A and S2B; the datatake-scoped composition keeps them as separate observations.

valid_pixel_counts.reason: the scl-explicit-allowlist-v2 mask is fail-closed and therefore undefined for a scene carrying an unreviewed processing baseline; counting valid pixels under it for the 1458 blocked scenes would produce a quantity the contract declares unavailable. Counts are deferred to the resumed Phase 1 after the section 5 review, so that plan counts and the Phase 2 reconciliation share one effective registry.
